title: `podman build`: `--rm` and `--force-rm` should require either `--layers=true` or `--no-cache`
body:
The `buildah build` command requires that, if `--rm` or `--force-rm` are passed, `--layers` must be set to true or `--no-cache` must be set.

Podman does not have the same requirement (though `--layers=true` is default, so this isn't often hit).

We should add the missing validation so that `podman build --layers=false --force-rm` fails, as it would with Buildah.
